blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Cadets from 12 nations have motored up to the summer capital to take part in the International Cadet Conference on Wednesday, hosted for the first time by the Philippine Military Academy. The cadet delegations represent 20 military schools, said Navy Lt. Commander Jesse Nestor Saludo, who heads the PMA information office. “For decades, military academies have been defined by their ability to forge discipline, instill resilience, and enforce adherence to time-tested doctrine. That foundation remains non-negotiable. However, the operational environment we are stepping into upon graduation does not respect traditional borders, nor does it wait for conventional solutions,” […]...
